literal: Agreeableness having yielded, goodness it will produce; benefit having yielded, from character not departing word.
translation: Words that yield practical benefit and never depart from good character will bring forth joy and produce lasting goodness.
modern: பயனைத் தந்து நல்ல பண்பிலிருந்து விலகாத சொற்கள், கேட்பவருக்கு மகிழ்ச்சியைத் தந்து நன்மையை உண்டாக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the dual positive effects of speaking sweet, character-driven words. The subject is words that yield practical benefit (பயன்) and never depart from good character (பண்பு). The predicate states that such words will bring forth immediate joy or agreeableness (நயன்) and produce lasting goodness (நன்றி). The repetition of the word 'ஈன்று' (having yielded) emphasizes that good words are fertile and productive, bearing fruit in both usefulness and emotional warmth.
